title: Gerchsheimer tricks Schauberger into signing over IP

tellings.quote: Gerchsheimer then tricks Schauberger into signing all of his IP over to the US which gets branded as atomic energy research.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells how in 1957 a man named Carl Gerchsheimer tricked Viktor Schauberger, an Austrian inventor, into signing over all his intellectual property, meaning the rights to his ideas and inventions, to the United States, with the story moving from Austria to Texas. Michels says that work was then relabelled as atomic energy research. He tells it, drawing on the writer Nick Cook, in a documentary about early secret flying-craft research, as a sign that unusual inventions were quietly taken into American programmes.
